    "My electrical connectors and inspection camera seem to suggest more specialized troubleshooting needs than I have actually shown."

  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Repeated hose clamp purchases give me a clearer reason to consider similar clamps than unrelated nuts or inserts, although the size still needs to fit my repair.",
    "I choose supplies for a particular use, so compatible dimensions, required tools and a useful pack quantity matter alongside a familiar repair purpose."
  ],

}
